item.title: Albert Einstein's 100-year-old handwritten letter filled with equations sells for $71,811
item.description: A handwritten letter by Albert Einstein, believed to date back to around 1929, has sold for $71,811 at RR Auction. Addressed to mathematician Chaim Herman Muntz, the one-page document contains detailed equations exploring Hamiltonian mechanics, covariance and invariance. Written in German, the letter was sold with its original envelope, postmarked in Potsdam, offering a glimpse into Einstein's mathematical discussions nearly a century ago. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

Según la Fiscalía Federal en Karlsruhe, se dedicaba a recopilar información militarmente relevante para una agencia de espionaje rusa y se enfrenta a una pena de hasta diez años de prisión. item.title: Man spent over 20 years restoring Spitfire aircraft in UK garage; project sells for £18,000
item.description: Peter Arnold, affectionately dubbed 'Mr Spitfire', dedicated over half a century to amassing historic aircraft relics. After his passing in 2025, a remarkable unfinished Spitfire fuselage went under the hammer for £18,000. This Spitfire F Mk 22 PK519 fuselage featured original components, resting in Arnold's garage for 20 years. Besides the fuselage, auctioned treasures included vintage aircraft instruments and a mesmerizing clock. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
